title.en: Medical termination of pregnancy and sexually transmitted infections
title.kn: ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಗರ್ಭಪಾತ ಮತ್ತು ಲೈಂಗಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹರಡುವ ಸೋಂಕುಗಳು

heading.en: Two health issues society hesitates to discuss
heading.kn: ಸಮಾಜ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಹಿಂಜರಿಯುವ ಎರಡು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳು

hook.en: Unsafe abortions and untreated infections harm many young people every year, often because nobody talked about them in time.
hook.kn: ಅಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಗರ್ಭಪಾತ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಪಡೆಯದ ಸೋಂಕುಗಳು ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಅನೇಕ ಯುವಜನರಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Intentional or voluntary termination of pregnancy before full term is MTP or induced abortion. India legalised MTP in 1971 with strict conditions to prevent misuse. Under the MTP (Amendment) Act, 2017, a pregnancy may be terminated within the first 12 weeks on the opinion of one registered medical practitioner, and between 12 and 24 weeks on the opinion of two. MTPs are relatively safe in the first trimester. Misuse for female foeticide and MTPs by unqualified quacks are dangerous.
body.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣಾವಧಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಗರ್ಭವನ್ನು ಕೊನೆಗೊಳಿಸುವುದು MTP. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ 1971ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾನೂನುಬದ್ಧವಾಯಿತು. ಮೊದಲ ತ್ರೈಮಾಸಿಕದಲ್ಲಿ (12 ವಾರಗಳವರೆಗೆ) ಇದು ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ.

points.en: Up to 12 weeks: one RMP; 12–24 weeks: two RMPs

say.en: Under the MTP (Amendment) Act, 2017, as given in NCERT, pregnancy can be ended up to 12 weeks on one doctor's opinion, and from 12 to 24 weeks on two doctors' opinion.
MTP is safest in the first trimester. Its misuse for female foeticide, and MTPs by unqualified quacks, are dangerous.
Sexually transmitted infections: most are completely curable if detected early, but hepatitis B, genital herpes and HIV are not.
Hepatitis B and HIV also spread through shared needles, infected blood, and from mother to foetus. People aged 15 to 24 are most at risk; condoms and safe practices prevent STIs.

body.en: Infections spread through sexual intercourse are STIs: gonorrhoea, syphilis, genital herpes, chlamydiasis, genital warts, trichomoniasis, hepatitis B and HIV. Hepatitis B and HIV can also spread by sharing injection needles, transfusion of infected blood, or from mother to foetus. Except hepatitis B, genital herpes and HIV infections, the others are completely curable if detected early. People aged 15–24 are at high risk. Prevention: avoid sex with unknown or multiple partners, always use condoms, and seek early treatment.
body.kn: ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಿಂದ ಹರಡುವ ಸೋಂಕುಗಳು STIಗಳು: ಗೊನೊರಿಯಾ, ಸಿಫಿಲಿಸ್, ಜನನಾಂಗ ಹರ್ಪಿಸ್, ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ B, HIV ಮುಂತಾದವು. ಹೆಪಟೈಟಿಸ್ B, ಜನನಾಂಗ ಹರ್ಪಿಸ್ ಮತ್ತು HIV ಹೊರತುಪಡಿಸಿ ಉಳಿದವು ಬೇಗ ಪತ್ತೆಯಾದರೆ ಗುಣಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು.

points.en: Not fully curable: hepatitis B, genital herpes, HIV
Untreated STIs can cause PID, ectopic pregnancy, infertility

problem.en: A student says all STIs can be cured with antibiotics. Is he right? Explain.

steps.en: Bacterial STIs such as gonorrhoea, syphilis and chlamydiasis can be cured if treated early.
Hepatitis B, genital herpes and HIV infection are viral and cannot be completely cured.
So prevention and early detection are essential.

answer.en: No. Hepatitis B, genital herpes and HIV are not completely curable
